findings.title: Stale @-strip documentation in the two owned test files should be updated together with the replaced expectations
findings.detail: Both strip-pinning tests are correctly identified for REPLACEMENT (messenger.test.ts:294 sets '@bob' and :305 asserts onSearchUsers.calledOnceWith('bob'); contacts.test.ts:140 sets 'b@ob', :149 asserts searchUsers.calledOnceWith('bob'), :161 asserts the re-rendered input value 'bob'), but the surrounding documentation also describes the removed behavior and is not named in plannedItems: the test title at messenger.test.ts:282 ('debounces the @-prefixed search and renders the typed results'), the suite comment at messenger.test.ts:245 ('@-поиск с дебаунсом'), the inline comment at contacts.test.ts:148 ('@» вырезан из значения'), and the handler comment at messenger.ts:421-422 ('@-поиск: ввод с префиксом @'). A worker following only the letter of 'REPLACE the @-strip expectations' could flip the assertions yet leave titles/comments documenting the strip. All occurrences are inside files already in the write-set, so no write-set change is needed.
findings.requiredFix: Not blocking. Treat 'REPLACE the @-strip expectations' as including the adjacent stale test titles and comments in the same files (messenger.test.ts:282/:245, contacts.test.ts:148, messenger.ts:421-422) so the suite does not document removed behavior. Historical feature-name labels elsewhere (messenger.ts:2/:20/:86/:176, chat.ts:4/:372, chat.test.ts:8, searchBar.ts:11) carry no strip behavior or assertion and may stay.

findings.title: Live smoke is NOTE-only evidence — explicit narrowing, acceptable for this local-only tier
findings.detail: EV-FE-1 is unit-level only (mocha pins + guard receipt); the live check 'typing alice@chatty.local finds the user' is an operator NOTE, not a gate (acceptance-criteria.md 'AC-PROCESS — scope discipline'). This is not a silent downgrade: releaseTarget is local-only with productionPromotionClaimed=false, and the changed surface is bracketed by independent pins on both sides — frontend verbatim pass-through (to be pinned in both test files) and backend @-prefix matching already pinned at backend/tests/integration/chat/test_social_api.py:129-130. The untouched wiring between them was verified to pass the login verbatim: messenger modal -> onSearchUsers -> ChatsController.searchUsers (src/features/chats/controller.ts:167-175) -> GET /users?login= (src/features/chats/api/own.ts:190-194); contacts modal -> ContactsController.searchUsers (src/features/contacts/controller.ts:69-77) -> GET /users?login= (src/features/contacts/api/own.ts:69-73). No other transform exists on the path (grep split('@') across src/ hits only messenger.ts:436 and contacts.ts:213).
findings.requiredFix: Not required — the narrowing is explicit and the claim is scoped to local-only. If the package is ever promoted toward a production claim, the live smoke must become a real gate at that point.

requirementFit.summary: Every factual claim reproduced in source: the @-strip block in the root-delegated input handler (messenger.ts:423-438, delegation filter :426) and the mirrored block (contacts.ts:212-215, comment :200-201); the hint lives once inside renderAddUserModalContent (messenger.ts:127 within :92-132) and the contacts page reuses that builder (contacts.ts:13 import, :269 addContent), so one hint edit covers both modals; backend needs no change — search_by_login_prefix escapes only backslash/%/_ and leaves '@' untouched (backend/app/repositories/users.py:34,38) and test_social_api.py:129-130 pins login='alice@ex' matching. Downstream controller/adapter path passes the query verbatim, so the two strips are the only mangling points. The fix is correctly frontend-only with prefix semantics preserved.

implementationQuality.summary: Single workstream, five-file write-set, no new imports/components; deleting the two strip blocks plus one shared hint string is the minimal correct change. Write-set is complete: split('@') occurs only at messenger.ts:436 and contacts.ts:213, the hint string only at messenger.ts:127, and the only tests asserting the strip are the two test files already in the write-set — nothing outside the write-set must change for the fix or for verify to pass. Base pin verified (90f8430 = feat(contacts) commit; HEAD e0b9c1e adds only the plan package).

evidenceQuality.summary: Validation commands are real and sufficient (npm run verify; guard-architecture --all --strict). The REPLACE-not-extend requirement is confirmed necessary and correctly scoped to BOTH files: messenger.test.ts:294+305 and contacts.test.ts:140+149+161 assert the strip today and would fail without replacement. Baseline reproduced independently: mocha 422 passing at HEAD (== base for src/), exactly as the launchGate claims. Completeness-check run by reviewer: PASS, zero blockers.

residualRisk.summary: Two minor, non-blocking notes (F-1 stale @-titles inside owned test files; F-2 live smoke as NOTE-only). No Medium/High findings. Orchestration fits the tier: S2 resolved deterministically via browser-risk (tier-resolution.json), 1 review round, maxTaskAttempts 2, maxParallelTasks 1, budgets scaled down and internally consistent (1800s workstream + 1800s retry reserve <= 3600s critical path <= 5400s run wall; 20k workstream tokens <= 30k total; package ~12KB fits the 60KB small-context plan budget).
